# NoServerRotate

**Category:** Player  
**Aliases:** NoServerRotate

## What it does

Prevents the server from rotating your camera.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Pan4ur/ThunderHack-Recode/blob/49c76bcc5a5e4fbd12b06305c09f0c8fb76c510b/src/main/resources/assets/thunderhack/lang/en_us.json). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
